state_support: Specific current branches identified in source mapping; all extra loading/stale/expanded states are proposed until context exists.

permission_contract: Proposed internal operator permission; not ordinary customer membership or subscription.
interaction_contract: Internal operator permission scope separate from customer tenancy; categories and review actions require backend contracts and recorded consent/time/rule inputs.

states.empty: No leads: no routing or contact action; internal scope only.
states.loading: Lead review: request pending only; preserve scope/current safe data. For server-rendered pages this is a proposed submitting cue, not a background worker state.
states.partial: Lead review: identify unavailable source/field/operation before conclusions; do not conflate missing evidence with no finding.
states.stale: Lead review: show actual observation/receipt or captured-object time; freshness policy required before stale badges. Snapshot history does not auto-update.
states.denied: Proposed internal operator permission; not ordinary customer membership or subscription.
